The functions \(f\) and \(g\) are given by \(f(x)=\int_{0}^{3 x} \sqrt{4+t^{2}} d t\) and \(g(x)=f(\sin x)\).
(a) Find \(f^{\prime}(x)\) and \(g^{\prime}(x)\).
(b) Write an equation for the line tangent to the graph of \(y=g(x)\) at \(x=\pi\).
(c) Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression that represents the maximum value of \(g\) on the interval
\(0 \leq x \leq \pi\). Justify your answer.
